# `armadad agent`

<!-- Generated by `make docs` from the commands; do not edit. -->

[All commands](armadad.md)

Run the node agent.

```
armadad agent [flags]
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--data-dir string` | directory holding the node certificate (default `/var/lib/armada`) |
| `--internal-dns` | serve <app>.internal to containers on this node (needs --proxy haproxy) (default `true`) |
| `--log-format string` | log format: text or json (default `text`) |
| `--proxy string` | ingress proxy: haproxy or none (default `haproxy`) |
| `--secrets-dir string` | tmpfs directory for secret files (default `/run/armada/secrets`) |
| `--server strings` | control plane addresses (default: from agent.json, kept up to date by the server) |
| `-v`, `--verbose` | debug logging |
